[SWS_DM_01092] EnableRapidPowerShutdown Positive Response
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04279
⌈
If a positive response for subfunction
EnableRapidPowerShutdown
shall be sent,
the DM shall put the configured value of
SoftwareClusterDiagnosticDeploy-
mentProps.powerDownTime
in its positive response.
